children: Seacoast Banking Corp of Florida reported Q2 2026 net income of $59.5 million and highlighted 16% annualized organic loan growth with a 14.3% Tier 1 capital ratio.
Net income $59.5M, $0.55 diluted EPS; adjusted net income $65.8M, $0.61 EPS — up 87% vs prior quarter.
Loans grew a 16.0% annualized during Q2; commercial pipeline $1.29B, up 24% sequentially.
Strong liquidity and capital: Tier 1 capital ratio 14.3% and tangible equity to tangible assets 9.3%.
Net interest income $182.2M; NIM stable at 3.83% (core NIM 3.65% excl. accretion on acquired loans).
2026 outlook: adjusted revenue target $656M (+28–31%), adjusted EPS $2.48–$2.52, and adjusted ROTE ~16.0%.
